run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T11:34:56Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by error spans on frontend-proxy itself: its ingress (server) and router frontend egress (client) spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and the ingress error ratio moved from 6.39% at 11:35:56 and 4.69% at 11:53:56 to a peak of 14.43% at 11:59:56. Two error paths produce those errors. The dominant one, already present when the alert opened, is a 15 s proxy timeout returning 504 UT response_timeout for POST /api/checkout: sampled traces show proxy ingress 504 at 15.0 s, frontend /api/checkout at 77.7 s, checkout PlaceOrder at 77.6 s, and checkout orders publish at 77.6 s ending in error with otel.status_description circuit breaker is open. Checkout logs show repeated failures to produce to topic orders (topic/partition does not exist, then circuit breaker open), an i/o timeout to the kafka Service IP 100.71.78.255:9092 and broker #1 deregistration; the earliest retained produce failure is 11:34:06.96Z, about 50 s before the alert anchor. Both Kafka brokers log broker-epoch and metadata errors (STALE_BROKER_EPOCH and StaleBrokerEpochException, expected broker epoch 17 but got 10), the deepest cause observed. A second, later contributor around 11:53-12:05 is the ad pod: its container was OOMKilled (exit 137) at 11:52:37Z and restarted, the ad service span rate fell to zero at 11:59:56 and 12:01:56, and the frontend AdService client-span errors track its /api/data errors exactly. All 21 deployments reported ready and all pods were Running and ready at query time; frontend-proxy was not restarted. No pre-incident baseline exists (traces_span_metrics series start about 11:35:56), so no latency or error trend is asserted, and the alert rule itself is absent from this Prometheus.

claims.text: frontend-proxy emits error spans on its own operations: over 10:34:56-12:13:56 increase() gives 1371.05 error spans on span_name ingress and 371.52 on span_name router frontend egress; the status_code label values present for the service are STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

frontend-proxy ingress error rate rose from 0.182 error spans per second at 11:35:56 to 1.24 at 11:59:56 and 1.144 at 12:01:56, falling to 0.278 by 12:07:56; the ingress error ratio over total ingress spans went from 6.39% at 11:35:56 and 4.69% at 11:53:56 to 14.43% at 11:59:56.

The frontend-proxy container access log shows the dominant error: POST /api/checkout answered 504 UT response_timeout with duration 15000-15002 ms on upstream cluster frontend; 852 such 5xx lines fall inside 11:48:00-12:03:15 and the read was cut at the 4 MiB limit, so later lines are unknown.

Two sampled traces at 11:44:55Z show the chain via parent references: frontend-proxy ingress span with error true and http.status_code 504 at 15.00 s, its child router frontend egress with error true and http.status_code 0 at 15.00 s, then frontend POST /api/checkout at 77.71 s with child grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder at 77.62 s, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder at 77.62 s with child orders publish at 77.60 s carrying error true, otel.status_code ERROR and otel.status_description circuit breaker is open.

checkout latency is dominated by the Kafka produce span: at 12:12:00 the p90 of span_name orders publish is 15000 ms and of oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is 15000 ms, while sibling spans are fast (CartService/EmptyCart 118 ms, CartService/GetCart 78 ms, CurrencyService/Convert 26 ms, PaymentService/Charge 50 ms, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 2.7 ms, HTTP POST 47 ms); summed over 99 minutes every PlaceOrder observation sits above the largest finite bucket (all finite le buckets 0, le +Inf 862).

The checkout container log ties the slow produce to Kafka: lines include a failure to produce message to topic orders with circuit breaker is open, client metadata got error from broker 1 while fetching metadata read tcp 100.96.1.134:53048 to 100.71.78.255:9092 i/o timeout, Closed connection to broker kafka:9092 and client brokers deregistered broker #1 at kafka:9092 at 12:03:04Z.

The earliest retained Kafka produce failure in the checkout pod is 11:34:06.961Z (Request was for a topic or partition that does not exist on this broker), followed immediately by circuit breaker is open lines from 11:34:07.866Z; in the window 11:29:00-11:34:22 all 14 matching lines were returned and none earlier in that window, and 11:29:00-11:34:44 shows 24 matches with the newest at 11:34:40.

Both Kafka broker pods log broker-epoch and metadata errors: kafka-ff7884766-skk8d repeats AssignmentsManager handleResponse 50 assignments failed with global error STALE_BROKER_EPOCH and retries every about 10 s from 11:35:24Z, and kafka-ff7884766-xclnk repeats QuorumController assignReplicasToDirs event failed with StaleBrokerEpochException, exception message expected broker epoch 17 but got broker epoch 10, plus matching ControllerApis nodeId=1 AssignReplicasToDirsRequestData brokerId=1 brokerEpoch=10 errors from 11:46:21Z.

The kafka Deployment declares 2 replicas, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-kafka, memory limit 900Mi and no volumes at all (the VOLUME column returned the none marker), so no persistent volume is declared for broker data.

The ad container of pod ad-554b849958-4chjq was OOMKilled: lastState terminated with reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, startedAt 11:23:00Z, finishedAt 11:52:37Z, restartCount 1; namespace events show Created container ad and Started container ad at 11:52:37Z. The ad Deployment memory limit is 450Mi.

After that restart the ad service stopped serving: its own span rate for getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds and oteldemo.AdService/GetAds is 0 at 11:59:56 and 12:01:56 (previously 0.36-0.68 per second), and the ad container log for 11:53:00-11:58:00 contains only Ad service starting at 11:57:29Z, with no request lines.

During the later phase the frontend AdService calls fail in lockstep with its /api/data errors: for 11:53:56-12:05:56 the error rates of frontend span_names GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds are identical (0.256, 0.641, 0.748, 0.678, 0.356, 0.033 per second), and tcp.connect errors appear at 11:55:56-12:01:56 (0.034, 0.041, 0.015, 0.015, 0.007).

A sampled frontend trace at 11:44:59Z shows the /api/data path via parent references - GET /api/data returning 200, then executing api route (pages) /api/data, then grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds - all succeeding at that time, so /api/data is an AdService-dependent handler.

Error-span increases over 11:46:00-12:06:00 are concentrated in frontend 1508.84, frontend-proxy 1353.36, checkout 488.97, ad 39.88, fraud-detection 2.05 and recommendation 2.05, with accounting 0 and payment 0.

All 21 Deployments in otel-demo report desired, available, ready and updated counts equal (kafka 2 of 2), and all 22 pods are Running and ready; frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-59tsm has restartCount 0, and the only pod with a restart is ad-554b849958-4chjq with 1. Pod startTimes cluster at 11:22:57-11:24:49Z.

Primary cause of the alert: checkout Kafka producer cannot deliver to topic orders (topic or partition does not exist, then an open circuit breaker after producer failures), so orders publish blocks for 76-78 s, PlaceOrder and frontend /api/checkout far exceed the proxy 15 s upstream timeout, and frontend-proxy answers POST /api/checkout with 504 UT response_timeout, which is what its error spans and the alert measure. The earliest observed produce failure at 11:34:06.96Z precedes the alert anchor 11:34:56Z and error rate was already 0.18-0.4 per second at the first available samples.

The deepest observed cause is Kafka-internal broker state inconsistency rather than checkout: both brokers repeatedly reject broker id 1 metadata with STALE_BROKER_EPOCH and StaleBrokerEpochException (expected broker epoch 17 but got broker epoch 10) and the checkout producer receives topic or partition does not exist on this broker plus metadata i/o timeouts to the kafka ClusterIP. A candidate explanation is loss or inconsistency of broker metadata state after the whole namespace was recreated around 11:22:57-11:22:58Z, consistent with the kafka Deployment declaring no volumes for broker data; this cannot be confirmed without change history or broker configuration.

A secondary contributor to the same alert between roughly 11:53 and 12:05: after the ad container was OOMKilled and restarted at 11:52:37Z the ad service stopped serving (span rate 0 at 11:59:56 and 12:01:56), the frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans failed, and the AdService-dependent /api/data route failed, adding up to about 0.75 error spans per second of proxy errors on top of the checkout path at the 11:59:56 peak. The exact failure mode of the GetAds calls is not visible because no trace sample exists for that period.

Rejected: a crash, restart or readiness failure of frontend-proxy does not explain the alert. The proxy pod is Running and ready with restartCount 0 since 11:22:57Z, its Deployment is 1 of 1 ready, its container has no previous instance, and its access log interleaves normal 200 and 308 traffic with the 504 lines.

checkout downstream gRPC dependencies are not the source of its 77 s duration: in the sampled 11:44:55Z traces, cart (GetCart, EmptyCart, HGET, HMSET, EXPIRE), currency (Convert), payment (Charge, charge), product-catalog (GetProduct), shipping (/get-quote, /ship-order), quote (calculate-quote), email (send_order_confirmation returning 200) and flagd (ResolveBoolean) spans all carry OK or 0 status, or none, with durations under 60 ms; only orders publish is in error and long.

Some services show no error signal of their own: payment span_names GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect and accounting span_name orders receive have error rate 0 across 11:30-12:14 and 11:46-12:06 respectively, and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series is returned for cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, email or quote during 11:46-12:06.

Advisory human follow-up: inspect and repair Kafka cluster state for otel-demo - confirm whether topic orders and its partitions exist and are assigned, resolve the broker-epoch disagreement between the controller and broker id 1, and consider whether the kafka Deployment should use persistent volumes instead of container-local storage. Verify with Kafka metadata tooling, which this Run could not query.

Also worth reviewing: the ad Deployment 450Mi memory limit against the observed OOMKill of the ad container, and whether the frontend /api/data route should degrade gracefully when AdService is unavailable so that an ad restart does not add proxy 5xx and 504 errors.
